title: User
description: JSON Schema for Sorsa common.User extracted from the OpenAPI v3 spec.

bio_urls.description: URLs found in the user's bio.

can_dm.description: Whether the account accepts direct messages.

created_at.description: Account creation date in ISO 8601 format.

favourites_count.description: Total number of tweets this user has liked.

followers_count.description: Number of accounts following this user.

followings_count.description: Number of accounts this user follows.

location.description: Location string from the user's profile.

media_count.description: Total number of media items posted by this user.

pinned_tweet_ids.description: IDs of the user's pinned tweets.

possibly_sensitive.description: Whether the account is flagged as possibly containing sensitive content.

profile_background_image_url.description: URL of the user's profile background image.

profile_image_url.description: URL of the user's avatar image.

protected.description: Whether the account's tweets are protected (private).

tweets_count.description: Total number of tweets posted by this user.

verified.description: Whether the account has a verified badge.
